tagline: Proprietary thermal energy storage technology using crushed rocks for industrial heat demand
hero_kpi_rationale: The key KPI is the 4 GWh manufacturing capacity of thermal storage modules, as it represents the transition to industrial scale and Brenmiller's future growth potential in an emerging market.

kpis.name: Manufacturing Capacity (GWh)
kpis.explanation: Maximum annual production capacity of thermal storage modules.
kpis.description: The company expects a capacity of 4 GWh per year once the factory in Israel is fully operational.
kpis.signal: Scaling up with a giga-factory under construction

kpis.name: Energy Efficiency (Efficiency)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of energy returned versus energy stored.
kpis.description: The bGen system achieves 97% efficiency in the heat storage and retrieval cycle.
kpis.signal: Highly efficient technology for thermal storage

kpis.name: Product Lifespan
kpis.explanation: Number of years the storage system remains operational.
kpis.description: bGen modules are designed to operate for over 30 years with unlimited cycles.
kpis.signal: High durability, a major advantage for industrial customers

kpis.name: Modular Range (10 to 1,000 MWh)
kpis.explanation: Range of available storage unit sizes.
kpis.description: Systems can be sized from 10 to 1,000 MWh depending on requirements.
kpis.signal: Installation flexibility for various industry sizes

risks.title: Dependence on proprietary bGen technology
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, strong language ("highly dependent"), stable trend, high weight as the technology is core to the business model.

risks.title: Competition in thermal energy storage
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of the rise of alternative energy and new technologies, concerned language, upward trend, strategic category for innovation.

risks.title: Dependence on key third-party suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Present in primary risks, assertive language ("vulnerable"), stable trend, direct operational impact on production.

risks.title: Changing regulation on energy storage
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of evolving regulatory framework, cautious but concerned language, upward trend, sector sensitive to public policies.

risks.title: Inadequate protection of intellectual property
risks.score_rationale: Central risk, strong language ("unable to compete effectively"), stable trend, high weight as IP is fundamental for differentiation.

risks.title: Dependence on key employees
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention in risks, concerned language ("highly dependent"), stable trend, direct impact on innovation and management.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of connected energy systems
risks.score_rationale: Present in a dedicated section (Item 16.K), serious tone, upward trend, increasing exposure with network digitization.

risks.title: Restricted transfer of technology outside Israel
risks.score_rationale: Linked to Israeli public grants, restrictive language, stable trend, strategic impact on international expansion.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the 20-F report or in product and strategy descriptions. The company focuses on thermal storage and industrial decarbonization.
